decisions.reason: Product A is an accessory closely related to existing trailer coupling know-how, so the firm can interpret results and improve it.
Product B is a core box car trailer series that builds directly on the firm's established trailer manufacturing capabilities, supporting learning and improvement.
Product C is a car transporter trailer within the firm's core trailer product range, so absorptive capacity is high and learning is feasible.
Product D is a low-bed trailer series aligned with the firm's existing production and design knowledge, enabling the firm to learn from early results.
